transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you lately or what brings you in today?

They... they sent me here. My lieutenant at the station made me come. 

I was just... I was moving the airway bags. Putting them in a pattern. I was repeating the dispatch numbers out loud because I knew it was right. He told me to stop and step away, but... I wouldn't. I couldn't. If I broke the sequence, it felt like the whole bay would just... go bad. So I didn't move. That's why they sent me.
When you were repeating the dispatch numbers and arranging the airway bags, did you feel like you had to do it a certain way to prevent something bad from happening?
I don't... I don't really know. Yeah. Just... like I said before. It just had to be that way. I couldn't stop.
When you were repeating the dispatch numbers and arranging the bags, were you trying to get rid of certain thoughts or feelings by doing it that way?
No. I wasn't... I don't think I was trying to get rid of anything. I just... it was just the numbers. That's all.
While you were repeating the dispatch numbers and arranging the airway bags, did you feel anxious or upset if you thought you might not do it correctly?
No. I wasn't... I didn't feel upset. I didn't really think about doing it wrong, I just... I was just doing the numbers. That's all.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don't seem to notice?
No. I don't... I don't think so. I just... I just see what's there.
